study: TH07 retail 1.00b five-pass SFT with parent Focus and Bomb probability targets
fit: Reuse the original 8 stratified source permutations at each step. For each of 16,000 human training windows cache the frozen parent's two-class Focus and Bomb softmax distributions. Optimize human direction CE plus human fire CE plus XY spatial CE plus eight times the sum of KL(parent||learner) for Focus and Bomb. Initial policy equals teacher. Scaling is fixed a priori. No teacher gating or confidence filtering. Held human and engineering original frames are used only to evaluate all three frozen final models.
candidate_release: Only the fixed lowest seed may be considered for original evaluation. Report pooled and each-seed human held metrics; candidate must gain >=2pp held macro-author movement accuracy vs the parent, lose <=0.5pp on human switch accuracy, and satisfy each of the two original-camera drift checks below. Do not select an alternate seed.

drift_gate.mask: Original HUD Bomb stock >0 on each exact saved camera row

scope: An offline behavior and localization pilot using the frozen six-author bank. Positive stock requirement applies only to the drift audit. Four action heads remain independently sampled by any subsequent ordinary Game Start runtime.
